propositions: resign.py:146 calls generation.collect() without ignore_untracked=True, defaulting to False and triggering strict git status check that includes untracked files, causing store-read-failure when any untracked file exists in tracker
orchestrator.py:650 drift-refresh probe silently falls back to full LLM re-review when untracked files exist, wrapped in exception handler that masks the failure as benign
attest.py:139 and attest.py:406 both call collect_plan_relation_snapshot() without ignore_untracked=True and abort signing on fallback path when untracked files present
untracked files in shared .tickets-tracker symlinked across concurrent sessions race signing operations across all sessions on the machine
fix passes ignore_untracked=True to all four call sites since untracked files cannot change committed head fingerprint
